thread:
Sam (AE): Quick POC ask from VaultPay. 3-week pilot, VPC-only, CMK, no external logs. Customer: 6k DAU, 2 calls/user/day, ~75 tokens/call. They want a tight budget cap and clear pass/fail criteria.
Priya (SE): Token calc: 6k * 2 * 75 = 900k tokens/day -> ~27M/month. For 3 weeks ~6.3M? hold on: 900k/day * 21 = 18.9M tokens total for pilot.
Rohit (Infra): Baseline throughput estimate: 120 RPS -> 120*75 = 9k tok/s. Spikes: marketing bursts up to 800 RPS for a few minutes -> 60k tok/s.
Priya (SE): GPU throughput ballparks: small ~1.2k tok/s, mid ~3k tok/s, large ~7k tok/s. For steady 9k tok/s -> ~3 mid GPUs or ~2 large GPUs. For bursts (60k tok/s) -> ~20 mid GPUs ephemeral or ~9 large GPUs.
Sam (AE): Customer budget target = $9k total for pilot. Can we fit?
Rohit (Infra): Two practical plans:
- Budget plan: reserve 1 large GPU for critical path + autoscale small/mid spot pool for daytime bursts + hosted overflow. Aggressive sampling (start 20%) and prefix caching to reduce tokens.
- Performance plan: reserve 2 large GPUs 24/7 (higher cost).
Priya (SE): Cost sketch (cloud-equivalent): large ~$45/hr, mid ~$12/hr. Budget plan estimate: infra ~$5.5k for 3 weeks (with spot burst usage), platform & token fees ~$2-3k -> total ~$8k-$9k. So doable if we enforce sampling and overflow.
Lena (Security): Security checklist: VPC peering, CMK with customer policy, audit export to their S3 for 90 days, no external logging. Questionnaire answers needed in 48 hours.
Priya (SE): Success criteria proposal for SOW (pass/fail):
1) Latency: p95 <= 700ms during 20% staged traffic week.
2) Reliability: e2e error rate <= 2%.
3) Quality: >= 90% on a 120-prompt eval set (automated scoring + 15 manual checks).
4) Cost cap: pilot total <= $9k.
5) Security: VPC + CMK validated with no external log sinks.
Rohit (Infra): Runbook bullets: network/KMS setup 2 business days, reserved infra provisioning 1-2 days, autoscale + canary routing 2 days. Load test we'll run:
```
heyload --rps 120 --burst-rps 800 --duration 8m --payload=vaultpay_prompts.json
```
Sam (AE): Good. I'll present Budget plan as default and list Performance as an upgrade. I'll ask them to accept 20% sampling for week 1 to hit budget. Also will request the questionnaire back in 48 hours.
POC-Bot: reservation_request created: vp-poc-6601 (status: pending_network)
Sam (AE): Thanks team 44d I'll draft SOW with criteria and timeline (target kickoff in 10 business days pending approvals).
